name: Snail Field of Flowers
source: maplestory.io /api/GMS/8/map/1010004 (local copy docs/research/raw/gms_v8/1010004.json); geometry identical in gms_v22
conventions: MapleStory px, y grows DOWNWARD. Tier ids T0.. sorted top-to-bottom (T0 = highest). Ladder from_tier = tier at the BOTTOM end, to_tier = tier at the TOP end (null = no foothold there). kind: ground = attached to map bottom; ledge = raised block standing on ground or an object top; floating = free platform; slope = sloped ground piece.

layering.gap: 480-px sheer drop under the rim; only the ~450-px vines cross it
layering.mid_row: T1/T2/T3 y-145 with small connectors T4/T5 y-85
layering.low_islands: T6 y95 (centre), T7/T8 y155, T9/T10 y215
layering.east_stair: T15 y455 -> T13 y395 -> T12 y335 -> T11 y275 -> T10 y215 -> T8 y155 -> T6 y95 (a diagonal 60-px stair rising from the east basin rim up and west to the centre island)

tiers.note: UPPER RIM SLAB: full map width (1878 px) and about 205-235 px thick (side walls reach y-420; the render underside is at about y-390). Not connected to the lower ground. It is the arrival level (11 spawn points) and holds exit east00 at x559. Its top has a wooden rail fence alternating with big bushes.
bottom stone of the east staircase

links: riser 60px DOWN east to T16 at x=-591
riser 60px DOWN east to T18 at x=-501
riser 60px UP east to T15 at x=411

tiers.note: basin floor (lowest walkable); clover flower carpet
links: riser 60px UP east to T17 at x=321

ladders.note: top y-431 ends inside the underside of the T0 slab (render slab bottom is at about y-390). No foothold at the top, so it is a climbable dead-end hanging from the slab.
top y-425 ends inside the underside of the T0 slab; bottom y-195 is 50 px above T3. No foothold at the top: climbable dead-end.

portals.source: https://maplestory.io/api/wz/GMS/8/Data/Map/Map/Map0/001010004.img/portal/11 (raw v8 WZ: pn=east00 pt=2 tm=1010002 tn=west00). Corroborated by /api/GMS/40/map/1010004 and by hidden-street 2005, which lists 'Small Field of Flowers' with a single connection, 'House in Townstreet'

npcs_note: v8 JSON npcs[] is empty for this map
terrain_style: Tile set tS=grassySoil (layer 1; layer 0 has no tiles). Same grass-over-olive-brown cobbled dirt as the other Rainbow Street hunting maps (v8 render). Background set bS=grassySoil: blue sky (no.0), drifting cumulus clouds (no.1), distant domed hill (no.2), big leafy tree (no.3), plus meadow strips no.5 (golden-green grass) and no.6 (meadow with a broken wooden fence, rocks and a yellow tree) instead of no.4. Decor (raw WZ objects, layer 1): wooden rail fences + big bushes on the rim, white-pink clover carpets, orange flower beds, purple flowers, butterflies. ALL 11 ropes use the green leafy vine sprite connect/rope/3, not the hemp rope used in the other maps.

notes: No left/right edge exits: rim walls stop at x=-1029/849 and the basin walls run down to y=780; exactly one non-spawn portal (east00 on the rim). Dead-end side map reached from Amherst Townstreet.
mobRate 1.2 (v8 JSON): faster respawn than the other three maps (1.0).
hidden-street 2005 calls this map 'Small Field of Flowers' and Amherst Townstreet 'House in Townstreet'.
A modern 'MapleStory Classic' database (meowdb.com/msclassic/maps/000001014) lists 34 spawns including Orange Mushroom. That differs from v8 (43 spawns, no Orange Mushroom), so it is not used.
